# PakAITools — FAQ Content Pack v2 (General · Category · Product)

**Site:** https://pakaitools.store · **WhatsApp:** +92 321 9305619 · **Last reviewed:** November 26, 2026
**Contents:** 1 general FAQ page (22 Q&As) · 15 category hubs (45 Q&As) · 179 product pages (1,074 Q&As) = **1,141 Q&As**, each page with one ready-to-paste JSON-LD `@graph` (BreadcrumbList + FAQPage).
Machine-readable copy of everything: `pakaitools-faq-pack-v2.json`.

## PART 0 — Read first: how to deploy

### 0.1 What was fixed from v1

| Problem in v1 | Fix in v2 |
|---|---|
| About 180 links pointed to `google.com/search?q=/product/...` | All URLs are canonical `https://pakaitools.store/...` paths |
| 322 doubled durations such as "1 Day (1 Day (24 Hours))" | Removed |
| "Dedicated or shared?" answered with "Subscription account (format confirmed via WhatsApp)" | Answer now states the real account type from each listing; 10 plans genuinely lack that detail (see 0.7) |
| "No international card needed" stated for every plan, but 5 offer plans need the buyer's own card for a $0 platform check | Those 5 now say so in Q1 and Q5 |
| "Changing credentials voids warranty" contradicted plans that tell you to change the password | Rules are now plan-specific |
| Contradictions (Claude API 1-day plan answered with VIP-plan refund text) | Rewritten |
| Unverifiable claims ("works reliably on PTCL/StormFiber", "widely used by Pakistani…", Non-PTA "Yes", USD price comparisons, commercial-use rights) | Reworded to what can be stated safely, or removed |
| Prices repeated inside questions and long answers | Price now lives only in Q1, Q5 and the "At a glance" line, so there is one place to update |
| Standalone FAQPage blocks, no breadcrumbs | One `@graph` per URL: BreadcrumbList + FAQPage |
| No general or category layer, everything templated per product | Added /faqs/ and 15 category hubs; product answers use each plan's own data |
| 8 products shared identical names | Disambiguated (e.g. "Figma Pro – 1 Year (Own-Account Upgrade)") |

### 0.2 Page types and what goes where

| Page | URL | FAQ source | JSON-LD nodes | Breadcrumb |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| General FAQ | `/faqs/` | Part 1 (22) | BreadcrumbList + FAQPage | Home › FAQs |
| Category hub | `/ai-apis/` … (15) | Part 2 (3 each) | BreadcrumbList + FAQPage | Home › Category |

The file assumes these site paths exist and return 200: `/faqs/`, `/payment-methods/`, `/refund-warranty-policy/`. Change them if yours differ.

### 0.3 Honest note on FAQ schema in 2026

Google has ended FAQ rich results for all sites (the phase-out began in 2023 for most sites), and removed the related Search Console and Rich Results Test support. Do **not** expect expandable FAQ snippets. `FAQPage` markup is still valid schema.org, it is harmless, and it gives search engines and AI answer engines a clean, structured copy of your Q&As. The real value comes from the **visible on-page text**, which is what Google, People Also Ask, voice assistants and AI engines read and quote. **BreadcrumbList is still supported** and still shows in results.

- Validate FAQ markup with the Schema Markup Validator (validator.schema.org) and BreadcrumbList with Google's Rich Results Test.
- If a theme or SEO plugin already outputs FAQPage markup, remove one of them. One FAQPage per URL.

### 0.4 Visible HTML pattern (must match the JSON-LD word for word)

```html
<section id="faq" aria-labelledby="faq-title">
  <h2 id="faq-title">Frequently Asked Questions about {Product name}</h2>
  <details><summary>{Question}</summary><p>{Answer}</p></details>
  <!-- Roman Urdu items: add lang="ur-Latn" -->
  <details lang="ur-Latn"><summary>{Question}</summary><p>{Answer}</p></details>
</section>
```

- Render the FAQ in the server HTML, not injected after a click or fetched later.
- Questions and answers in the page and in the JSON-LD must be identical (escape `&` as `&amp;` in HTML only).
- Put the "At a glance" line (Part 3) visibly above the FAQ; it gives AI engines a clean fact block.
- Add a small "Last reviewed" date and keep it truthful.

### 0.5 Breadcrumb rules

- The visible breadcrumb trail must match the schema: same names, same order, same URLs.
- Category names follow your Browse Categories labels. The last item is the product's visible H1/title: confirm that it matches how your page names the product.
- Use absolute canonical URLs with the same trailing-slash style as your canonical tags.
- One BreadcrumbList per page. If your theme or SEO plugin already outputs one, keep theirs and add only the FAQPage node to the same `@graph`.

### 0.6 Crawl and index checklist

- Self-referencing canonical on every product, category and /faqs/ page; no `noindex`.
- Every page in the XML sitemap. Update `lastmod` only when the page content really changes.
- Internal links: product → its category hub → /faqs/; category → its products; footer links to /faqs/, /payment-methods/ and /refund-warranty-policy/.
- Do not block `/product/`, CSS or JS in robots.txt.
- Keep distinct titles, H1s and meta descriptions for the 8 look-alike products so they are not treated as duplicates.
- After launch: URL Inspection → request indexing for /faqs/, the 15 category hubs and your top products; watch Search Console › Pages for "Duplicate without user-selected canonical" and "Crawled – currently not indexed".

### 0.7 Writing rules used (AEO / GEO) and owner checklist

**Rules used:** answer first; the product is named in the first sentence; facts (price, duration, warranty, account type) come from one data source; one brand spelling (PakAITools), one number format (+92 321 9305619) and one currency format (Rs.). Most answers are 35–65 words; the longest are warranty answers that carry a plan-specific rule. Roman Urdu items are tagged `ur-Latn`.

**Before you publish, please confirm:**

1. **Paths and labels:** the three URL paths in 0.2, and that product and category names match your visible titles and breadcrumbs.
2. **10 plans where the listing does not say the account type, device limit or setup:** their FAQ currently tells buyers to confirm on WhatsApp. Replace it with the real answer when you can: #151 MiniMax M Plan Explore – 1 Month, #270 Claude Pro Extension-based – 1 Month, #263 Meshy AI Starter Plan – 1 Month, #190 Suno AI Premier – 1 Month, #224 Wispr Flow Pro – 2 Months, #257 HBO Max – 1 Month, #258 Paramount+ – 1 Month, #259 ALTBalaji – 1 Month, #261 Chaupal – 1 Month, #256 Avira Phantom VPN – 3 Months.
3. **5 plans that need the buyer's own card for a $0 platform check:** the notice is in Q1/Q5; keep it: #79, #139, #163, #164, #225.
4. **Brand-relationship wording** (General FAQ "Is PakAITools affiliated with the brands it sells?"): edit it if you are an authorised reseller for some brands.
5. **Category price ranges** (Part 2, first question) are computed from the 179 products in this pack. Your home page shows more plans per category (for example VPN 22 here vs 20). Recompute from the full catalogue or remove the numbers.
6. **Claims to keep checking:** ChatGPT availability in Pakistan without a VPN, Netflix's 15 Mbps UHD guidance, and any platform rule that changes. Update the pack when prices or warranties change, using the JSON file.

## PART 1 — GENERAL FAQs (`https://pakaitools.store/faqs/`)

**Breadcrumb:** Home › FAQs · **Suggested H1:** PakAITools FAQs: Buying, Delivery and Warranty in Pakistan


#### Ordering & payment

**Q1:** How can I buy from PakAITools in Pakistan without a credit card?
**A1:** Pay in Pakistani rupees through JazzCash, EasyPaisa, SadaPay, NayaPay or Raast—no international credit card is needed for PakAITools checkout. Choose your plan, pay, then send your payment receipt to WhatsApp (+92 321 9305619) to start delivery. A few promo or offer plans need your own card for the platform's $0 verification, and the product page says so.

**Q2:** Which payment methods does PakAITools accept?
**A2:** PakAITools accepts local PKR payments through JazzCash, EasyPaisa, SadaPay, NayaPay and Raast. After paying, send your receipt on WhatsApp (+92 321 9305619) so your order can be confirmed and delivered.

**Q3:** Are prices listed in Pakistani rupees, and why do some plans show a live PKR quote?
**A3:** Yes, plans are priced in PKR. API token and credit plans use a live PKR quote because upstream USD and token rates change, so message WhatsApp (+92 321 9305619) to get today's rate before you pay.

**Q4:** How do I place and confirm an order?
**A4:** Open the plan you want and check its price, duration, warranty and account type. Pay in PKR through a local method, then send your receipt to WhatsApp (+92 321 9305619). PakAITools confirms the payment and delivers your access privately on WhatsApp.


#### Delivery & account types

**Q5:** How is my order delivered?
**A5:** After payment confirmation, PakAITools delivers privately on WhatsApp. Depending on the plan you receive a ready account login, an activation key or redemption code, an invite or upgrade link for your own account, an API key, or an eSIM QR code, together with setup instructions.

**Q6:** What is the difference between a dedicated account, an own-account upgrade and a slot?
**A6:** A dedicated account is a ready login provisioned for you. An own-account upgrade or invite applies the plan to your existing account or email. A slot is a profile or seat inside a shared account or a family or workspace group, with its own device rules. Each product page states which type the plan is.

**Q7:** Do I need to share my password with PakAITools?
**A7:** It depends on the plan. Invite and link activations, such as Apple Family Sharing, Canva and Google Family invites, need no password. Some own-account upgrades need your login details so the upgrade can be applied, and you change the password afterwards as instructed. Share credentials only privately with PakAITools support on WhatsApp (+92 321 9305619).

**Q8:** Can I change the email or password of a delivered account?
**A8:** Follow the rules on your plan's page. For most ready accounts, log in with the delivered credentials and keep the email, password and billing or security settings unchanged to keep your warranty valid. A few plans tell you to change the password after login or activation; follow those exact steps.

**Q9:** How many devices can I use with my plan?
**A9:** Device limits differ by plan. Some allow 1 device, others up to 2, 5 or 10, as on certain VPN, design and streaming plans. The limit is shown in each plan's account details, and exceeding it or sharing the login can void your warranty.


#### Warranty & refunds

**Q10:** What warranty do PakAITools plans come with?
**A10:** It depends on the plan. Some budget or promo plans have none, shorter plans carry windows from 24 hours to a few days, and longer plans carry up to 12 months, 1 year or 300 days. The exact length and what it covers are on each product page and in the Refund & Warranty Policy.

**Q11:** What does the warranty cover and what voids it?
**A11:** Warranty covers plan or access failures on our side during the warranty window, usually through a replacement, and on some API plans through a pro-rated refund for unused tokens. It is voided by changing locked account details, exceeding device limits, using prohibited tools or breaking the platform's policies.

**Q12:** How do I claim a replacement under warranty?
**A12:** Message WhatsApp support (+92 321 9305619) inside your warranty window with a screenshot of the problem and your order details. If the issue is on our side, PakAITools replaces the account or resolves it as the plan's warranty allows.

**Q13:** Are refunds available?
**A13:** Refund terms vary by plan. Some API plans give a pro-rated refund for unused tokens if the key fails within warranty, while license keys, promo links and some other plans are non-refundable once issued. Check the plan's warranty line and the Refund & Warranty Policy before you pay.

**Q14:** What if a plan has no warranty?
**A14:** Some budget or promo plans, such as the 1-day unlimited API package and certain promo links, carry no warranty and no refund. Check your access as soon as it is delivered and read the plan's warranty line before ordering.


#### Using plans in Pakistan

**Q15:** Do I need a VPN to use these services in Pakistan?
**A15:** It depends on the service. Some plans, such as the Netflix Premium 4K slots, are listed as no VPN, while region-restricted platforms such as HBO Max and Paramount+ need VPN and device guidance confirmed on WhatsApp (+92 321 9305619) first. Check the product page or ask support before you log in.

**Q16:** Can agencies and teams order in bulk?
**A16:** Bulk pricing is available on request for some plans. Listings such as Figma Pro and Canva Pro (1 Year) mention bulk or team discounts via WhatsApp. Message +92 321 9305619 with the plan name and the number of seats you need.


#### Support & trust

**Q17:** How do I contact PakAITools support?
**A17:** Message PakAITools support on WhatsApp at +92 321 9305619 for payments, delivery, setup help and warranty claims.

**Q18:** Is PakAITools affiliated with the brands it sells?
**A18:** PakAITools is an independent online marketplace. Brand names, logos and trademarks belong to their respective owners and are used only to identify the plans sold. Read each product page to see exactly what is included.


#### Roman Urdu

**Q19:** PakAITools se bina credit card kaise buy karein?
**A19:** JazzCash, EasyPaisa, SadaPay, NayaPay ya Raast se PKR mein payment karein; PakAITools checkout ke liye international card ki zaroorat nahi. Payment ke baad receipt WhatsApp (+92 321 9305619) par bhej dein, delivery wahin milti hai.

**Q20:** Kya mujhe apna password share karna parega?
**A20:** Yeh plan par munhasir hai. Invite ya link wale plans mein password ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Kuch own-account upgrades mein login details chahiye hoti hain aur activation ke baad password badalna parta hai. Details sirf WhatsApp support ko private tor par dein.

**Q21:** Warranty ya replacement kaise claim karein?
**A21:** Warranty ki muddat ke andar WhatsApp (+92 321 9305619) par masle ka screenshot aur order ki tafseel bhejein. Masla hamari taraf se ho toh replacement ya eligible hal diya jata hai. Email ya password badalna ya device limit paar karna warranty khatam kar sakta hai.

**Q22:** Delivery kaise milti hai?
**A22:** Payment confirm hone ke baad delivery WhatsApp par private tor par milti hai: ready account, activation key, invite ya upgrade link, ya eSIM QR code, saath setup ki hidayaat. Har plan ka format uske product page par likha hota hai.

**Q2:** Can I buy AI APIs in Pakistan with JazzCash or EasyPaisa without a credit card?
**A2:** Yes. Pay for AI APIs plans in PKR through JazzCash, EasyPaisa, SadaPay, NayaPay or Raast, then send your receipt to PakAITools on WhatsApp (+92 321 9305619) for delivery.
